ev.q: Subnautica is an underwater adventure game set on an alien ocean planet
explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more
Build bases on the sea floor
the monsters are creepy enough to give you goosebumps
The world is full of beauty and color
A massive, open world full of wonder and peril awaits you
Some of it helpful, much of it harmful
gradually discover the disease, the alien structures and what's really going on
